Looking at this problem, I'll set up coordinates and compute each point.

## Setup

Place $A=(0,0)$, $B=(5,0)$, $C=(4,4\sqrt3)$ (since $AC=8$, $\angle A=60°$).

**Side lengths:** $a=BC=7$, $b=CA=8$, $c=AB=5$. Semiperimeter $s=10$.

**Midpoints:**
$$M=\left(\tfrac92, 2\sqrt3\right),\quad N=(2,2\sqrt3),\quad P=\left(\tfrac52,0\right).$$

**Tangency points** (tangent length from $A$ is $s-a=3$):
$$F=(3,0),\quad E=\left(\tfrac32,\tfrac{3\sqrt3}{2}\right).$$

## Lines EF, MN, MP

**Line EF:** slope $=-\sqrt3$, equation $y=-\sqrt3(x-3)$.

**Line MN:** $y=2\sqrt3$ (horizontal).

**Line MP:** slope $=\sqrt3$, equation $y=\sqrt3\!\left(x-\tfrac52\right)$.

## Points U, V

**U** = EF ∩ MN: $-\sqrt3(x-3)=2\sqrt3 \Rightarrow x=1$, so $U=(1,2\sqrt3)$.

**V** = EF ∩ MP: $-\sqrt3\,x+3\sqrt3=\sqrt3\,x-\tfrac{5\sqrt3}{2} \Rightarrow x=\tfrac{11}{4}$, $y=\tfrac{\sqrt3}{4}$, so $V=\left(\tfrac{11}{4},\tfrac{\sqrt3}{4}\right)$.

## Point X (midpoint of arc BAC)

The midpoint of the major arc $\widehat{BAC}$ lies on the **external** angle bisector at $A$. The internal bisector points at $30°$; the external bisector has direction $(-\tfrac12,\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2})$.

**Circumcircle:** Center $O=(\tfrac52,\tfrac{11\sqrt3}{6})$, radius $R=\tfrac{7}{\sqrt3}$.

Parametrize the external bisector: $(x,y)=(-\tfrac{t}{2},\tfrac{t\sqrt3}{2})$. Substituting into the circumcircle equation:

$$\left(\tfrac{t}{2}+\tfrac52\right)^2+3\left(\tfrac{t}{2}-\tfrac{11}{6}\right)^2=\tfrac{49}{3}$$

Expanding: $t^2-3t+\tfrac{49}{3}=\tfrac{49}{3}$, giving $t=0$ (point $A$) or $t=3$. Thus:

$$X=\left(-\tfrac32,\tfrac{3\sqrt3}{2}\right).$$

**Verification:** $|XB|^2=\tfrac{169}{4}+\tfrac{27}{4}=49$ and $|XC|^2=\tfrac{121}{4}+\tfrac{75}{4}=49$, so $|XB|=|XC|=7$. ✓

## Area of △XUV

Vectors from $X$:
$$\vec{XU}=\left(\tfrac52,\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\right),\quad \vec{XV}=\left(\tfrac{17}{4},-\tfrac{5\sqrt3}{4}\right).$$

$$\text{Area}=\tfrac12\left|\vec{XU}\times\vec{XV}\right|=\tfrac12\left|\tfrac52\cdot\!\left(-\tfrac{5\sqrt3}{4}\right)-\tfrac{17}{4}\cdot\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\right|=\tfrac12\left|-\tfrac{25\sqrt3}{8}-\tfrac{17\sqrt3}{8}\right|=\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac{42\sqrt3}{8}.$$

$$\boxed{\dfrac{21\sqrt3}{8}}$$
